column9: Generally the DS (Disposition) domain is the subject disposition through the study protocol, not the disposition of a study visit. For treatment completion consider recording the treatments in EX as EXTRT. The Subject Visits would reflect the encounter, the EXTRT would reflect the completion of the treatment. If there is a scenario where they would start the treatment and stop it (incomplete treatment) consider using the dose to reflect this or use a SUPPEX; QNAM=CMPTRT; QLABEL=Completed Treatment.
